subject.title: fix(mcp): stop ignored disabled servers from starting

question: Should legacy MCP `disabled` values in include layouts that cannot be rewritten safely fail validation and require direct operator repair?
rationale: The code and proof support the narrow migration, but choosing an explicit validation stop for unsupported existing include layouts is an observable compatibility and operator-action decision.

options.title: Accept guarded fail-closed migration
options.body: Automatically repair only root and unambiguous single-include ownership cases, while requiring direct edits for complex layouts.

options.title: Expand include repair first
options.body: Delay the validation change until additional include ownership patterns can be migrated without flattening or overwriting authored configuration.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded fail-closed migration
recommendation.body: Automatically repair only root and unambiguous single-include ownership cases, while requiring direct edits for complex layouts.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest merged history on the affected MCP configuration and operator contract.
